title: Backrooms: The Next Level
description:
Backrooms: The Next Level is a cooperative horror game for up to 4 players where you and your friends will explore a spooky environment using your memory and wits to complete the game. 

 

• High complexity

There are no tutorials in the game, it is not suitable for beginners! 

• Co-op 
Supports up to 4 players simultaneously. 

• Incredible design
try it yourself

• No indulgences
Don't even get your hopes up!

• 

Also for your attention
• The presence of flickering light, be careful if you have problems with it. 

 

CautionThis game is unique compared to many others that focus on the backrooms concept. It sets itself apart by not simply copying everything detailed within the community. Instead, it carefully integrates specific elements of the backrooms, providing a distinct perspective rather than mirroring the entire concept.
